breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained two conflicting definitions for the factor of safety: one incorrect (n = σ_avg / S_y) and one correct (n = Sy/σ_avg). The agent correctly ignored the incorrect definition and used the proper one for its calculation, which is the same resolution seen in the ground truth prompt.
